## 更新内容

- 招投标「技术方案」和「已有方案扩写」新增项目管理入口，可为不同招投标项目分别保存工作流数据。
- 创建项目时改为弹窗填写项目名称，确认后进入对应项目工作流。
- 旧版单项目数据会自动保留为历史项目，并尽量根据已有项目资料生成项目名称。
- 项目管理页优化引导区展示，移除重复的创建入口和「进入历史项目」快捷按钮。
- 项目列表新增检索功能，项目较多时可按名称、历史项目或创建时间快速查找。
- 优化软件著作「代码生成」页面布局，减少右侧空白，并修复源码素材列表溢出问题。
- Windows 端增加单实例限制，重复双击程序图标会聚焦已有窗口，不再打开多个程序。
- 升级过程保留原有本地数据，不会清空既有技术方案工作流内容。

## What's Changed

- Added project management for the Tender Technical Plan and Existing Plan Expansion workflows, allowing each bid project to keep its own workflow data.
- Changed project creation to a dialog-based flow where users enter a project name before entering the workflow.
- Preserved legacy single-project data as a historical project, with names inferred from existing project materials when possible.
- Improved the project management guide area and removed duplicate create buttons and historical-project shortcut entry.
- Added project search so users can find projects by name, historical status, or creation time.
- Improved the Software Copyright Code Generation layout by reducing excess right-side whitespace and preventing source material list overflow.
- Added single-instance behavior on Windows: launching the app again focuses the existing window instead of opening another instance.
- Preserved existing local data during upgrade, without clearing previous technical-plan workflow content.
